scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,alice,bob -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @collabhub/todo-list-app dev:server" "pnpm --filter @collabhub/todo-list-app dev:web:a" "pnpm --filter @collabhub/todo-list-app dev:web:b"
scripts.dev:blocknote: concurrently -k -n server,alice,bob -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @collabhub/blocknote-app dev:server" "pnpm --filter @collabhub/blocknote-app dev:web:a" "pnpm --filter @collabhub/blocknote-app dev:web:b"
scripts.dev:react-flow: concurrently -k -n server,alice,bob -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @collabhub/react-flow-app dev:server" "pnpm --filter @collabhub/react-flow-app dev:web:a" "pnpm --filter @collabhub/react-flow-app dev:web:b"
scripts.dev:yjs-hybrid: concurrently -k -n collabhub,yjs,alice,bob -c blue,yellow,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @collabhub/yjs-hybrid-app dev:collabhub" "pnpm --filter @collabhub/yjs-hybrid-app dev:yjs" "pnpm --filter @collabhub/yjs-hybrid-app dev:web:a" "pnpm --filter @collabhub/yjs-hybrid-app dev:web:b"
scripts.capture:product-hunt: pnpm --filter @collabhub/react-flow-app build && pnpm --filter @collabhub/react-flow-app build:server && node scripts/capture-product-hunt-assets.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @collabhub/todo-list-app build && pnpm --filter @collabhub/blocknote-app build && pnpm --filter @collabhub/react-flow-app build && pnpm --filter @collabhub/yjs-hybrid-app build && pnpm test:unit && pnpm benchmark
scripts.smoke:demo: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @collabhub/react-flow-app build && pnpm --filter @collabhub/react-flow-app build:server && node scripts/smoke-public-demo.mjs
scripts.release:check: pnpm check && pnpm build:distributed && node scripts/check-package-artifacts.mjs
scripts.pack:packages: pnpm build && pnpm build:distributed && node scripts/check-package-artifacts.mjs --output artifacts/packages
